description: This trendy Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread is a delightful fusion of sweet and savory flavors, featuring a soft bread generously filled with a creamy, slightly sweet cheese mixture. Each segment is then drenched in a rich garlic butter sauce, creating an irresistible aroma and taste. It's a perfect treat for brunch, a snack, or a unique appetizer that will impress everyone.

instructions.title: Prepare the Bread
instructions.text: Preheat your oven to 350F (175C). Using a sharp knife, make 6-8 deep cuts into the round bread loaf, ensuring not to cut all the way through the bottom. These cuts should form a crisscross pattern, creating individual sections.

instructions.title: Make the Cream Cheese Filling
instructions.text: In a medium bowl, combine the softened cream cheese, 3 tablespoons of granulated sugar, heavy cream, and the egg yolk. Mix thoroughly with a whisk or spatula until the mixture is completely smooth and creamy. Transfer this filling into a piping bag or a Ziploc bag with one corner snipped off.

instructions.title: Fill the Bread
instructions.text: Carefully pipe the cream cheese filling into each cut of the bread, ensuring an even distribution. Gently spread some of the filling on top of the bread's surface if you have extra or prefer a richer top layer.

instructions.title: Prepare the Garlic Butter Dip
instructions.text: In a separate bowl, melt the unsalted butter. Add the minced garlic, 1 tablespoon of granulated sugar, chopped fresh parsley, the beaten whole egg, and milk. Whisk all the ingredients together vigorously until they are well combined and form a cohesive dip.

instructions.title: Dip and Coat the Bread
instructions.text: Generously dip each section of the filled bread into the prepared garlic butter mixture, making sure the cuts and sides are thoroughly coated. You can also spoon the mixture over the top of the bread. Place the fully coated bread on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.

instructions.title: Bake to Golden Perfection
instructions.text: Bake the bread in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the bread is beautifully golden brown and the cream cheese filling is bubbly, slightly caramelized, and warm throughout.

instructions.title: Serve Warm
instructions.text: Remove the Korean Cream Cheese Garlic Bread from the oven. Allow it to cool for a few minutes before slicing and serving. Enjoy this irresistible sweet and savory treat warm.

tips: For an authentic Korean bakery taste, use a soft, slightly sweet bread like brioche or milk bread. This provides the perfect base for the rich fillings and ensures a tender texture.
If fresh parsley is unavailable, dried parsley can be used, but reduce the amount to 1 tablespoon as its flavor is more concentrated. However, fresh is always recommended for best aroma and color.

Store any leftover bread in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 2 days, or refrigerate for up to 4 days. Reheat gently in an oven or air fryer for 5-7 minutes to restore its crispy exterior and warm, gooey center.
